questions_before_times: What do you want insulated? (attic, walls, basement or crawl space)
Rough size of the area, or just a guess
The year the home was built (older homes may have old loose-fill or cloth-covered wiring that must be checked first)
safety_stop: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, a burning smell from the attic or a light, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
a ceiling sagging or falling, soaked insulation hanging down
license: if: a contractor or insulation registration or license for the company, where the state's form requires one (often by job size or kind of work)
